answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through environmental entropy attestation. Nodes validate identity by submitting signed physical telemetry, such as acoustic swell across an ocean, ambient reflectance from raw jade, or barometric flux in a karst cavern. An attacker incurs the verifiable hardware deployment cost of maintaining distinct physical sensors per persona. However, spatial interpolation models can allow adversaries to synthesize plausible sensor data across unmonitored zones.
